nitroxanalyser.changelog: Detects the printer model and the loaded label roll, then prints at the correct size and resolution automatically. Fixes labels printing at two-thirds size on 300 DPI printers such as the B1 Pro. Shows the printer's battery level, and keeps a licensed device licensed if the signing key changes.
